16: /-!
17: # Basic operations on the integers
18: 
19: This file builds on `Data.Int.Init` by adding basic lemmas on integers.
20: depending on Mathlib definitions.
21: -/
22: 
23: @[expose] public section
24: 
25: open Nat
26: 
27: namespace Int
28: variable {a b c d m n : ℤ}
29: 
30: -- TODO: Tag in Lean
31: attribute [simp] natAbs_pos

33: @[gcongr] alias ⟨_, GCongr.ofNat_le_ofNat⟩ := ofNat_le

35: instance instNontrivial : Nontrivial ℤ := ⟨⟨0, 1, Int.zero_ne_one⟩⟩

38: 
39: section inductionOn'
40: 
41: variable {C : ℤ → Sort*} (z b : ℤ)
42:   (H0 : C b) (Hs : ∀ k, b ≤ k → C k → C (k + 1)) (Hp : ∀ k ≤ b, C k → C (k - 1))
43: 
44: variable {z b H0 Hs Hp}
45: 
46: lemma inductionOn'_add_one (hz : b ≤ z) :
47:     (z + 1).inductionOn' b H0 Hs Hp = Hs z hz (z.inductionOn' b H0 Hs Hp) := by
48:   apply cast_eq_iff_heq.mpr
49:   lift z - b to ℕ using Int.sub_nonneg.mpr hz with zb hzb
50:   rw [show z + 1 - b = zb + 1 by lia]
51:   have : b + zb = z := by lia
52:   subst this
53:   convert cast_heq _ _
54:   rw [Int.inductionOn', cast_eq_iff_heq, ← hzb]
55: 
56: end inductionOn'
57: 
58: section strongRec
59: 
60: variable {P : ℤ → Sort*} {lt : ∀ n < m, P n} {ge : ∀ n ≥ m, (∀ k < n, P k) → P n}
61: 
62: lemma strongRec_of_ge :
63:     ∀ hn : m ≤ n, m.strongRec lt ge n = ge n hn fun k _ ↦ m.strongRec lt ge k := by
64:   refine m.strongRec (fun n hnm hmn ↦ (Int.not_lt.mpr hmn hnm).elim) (fun n _ ih hn ↦ ?_) n
65:   rw [Int.strongRec, dif_neg (Int.not_lt.mpr hn)]
66:   congr; revert ih
67:   refine n.inductionOn' m (fun _ ↦ ?_) (fun k hmk ih' ih ↦ ?_) (fun k hkm ih' _ ↦ ?_) <;> ext l hl
68:   · rw [inductionOn'_self, strongRec_of_lt hl]
69:   · rw [inductionOn'_add_one hmk]; split_ifs with hlm
70:     · rw [strongRec_of_lt hlm]
71:     · rw [ih' fun l hl ↦ ih l (Int.lt_trans hl k.lt_succ), ih _ hl]
72:   · rw [inductionOn'_sub_one hkm, ih']
73:     exact fun l hlk hml ↦ (Int.not_lt.mpr hkm <| Int.lt_of_le_of_lt hml hlk).elim
74: 
75: end strongRec
76: 
77: /-! ### nat abs -/
78: 
79: lemma natAbs_surjective : natAbs.Surjective := fun n => ⟨n, natAbs_natCast n⟩
80: 
81: lemma pow_right_injective (h : 1 < a.natAbs) : ((a ^ ·) : ℕ → ℤ).Injective := by
82:   refine (?_ : (natAbs ∘ (a ^ · : ℕ → ℤ)).Injective).of_comp
83:   convert Nat.pow_right_injective h using 2
84:   rw [Function.comp_apply, natAbs_pow]
85: 
86: /-! ### dvd -/
87: 
88: @[norm_cast] theorem ofNat_dvd_natCast {x y : ℕ} : (ofNat(x) : ℤ) ∣ (y : ℤ) ↔ OfNat.ofNat x ∣ y :=
89:   natCast_dvd_natCast
90: 
91: @[norm_cast] theorem natCast_dvd_ofNat {x y : ℕ} : (x : ℤ) ∣ (ofNat(y) : ℤ) ↔ x ∣ OfNat.ofNat y :=
92:   natCast_dvd_natCast
93: 
94: lemma natCast_dvd {m : ℕ} : (m : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ m ∣ n.natAbs := by
95:   obtain hn | hn := natAbs_eq n <;> rw [hn] <;> simp [← natCast_dvd_natCast, Int.dvd_neg]
96: 
97: lemma dvd_natCast {n : ℕ} : m ∣ (n : ℤ) ↔ m.natAbs ∣ n := by
98:   obtain hn | hn := natAbs_eq m <;> rw [hn] <;> simp [← natCast_dvd_natCast, Int.neg_dvd]
99: 
100: lemma eq_zero_of_dvd_of_nonneg_of_lt (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hmn : m < n) (hnm : n ∣ m) : m = 0 :=
101:   eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natAbs_lt_natAbs hnm (natAbs_lt_natAbs_of_nonneg_of_lt hm hmn)
102: 
103: /-- If two integers are congruent to a sufficiently large modulus, they are equal. -/
104: lemma eq_of_mod_eq_of_natAbs_sub_lt_natAbs {a b c : ℤ} (h1 : a % b = c)
105:     (h2 : natAbs (a - c) < natAbs b) : a = c :=
106:   Int.eq_of_sub_eq_zero (eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natAbs_lt_natAbs (dvd_self_sub_of_emod_eq h1) h2)
107: 
108: lemma natAbs_le_of_dvd_ne_zero (hmn : m ∣ n) (hn : n ≠ 0) : natAbs m ≤ natAbs n :=
109:   not_lt.mp (mt (eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natAbs_lt_natAbs hmn) hn)
110: 
111: theorem gcd_emod (m n : ℤ) : (m % n).gcd n = m.gcd n := by
112:   conv_rhs => rw [← m.emod_add_mul_ediv n, gcd_add_mul_left_left]
